.resetpassword — set someone's password (owner)

  .resetpassword <name>   two gates, then it is set

The backstop for a resident who has lost both their password and their
recovery codes. You type the new password twice (same rules as .passwd:
8-128 characters, common ones refused), then your OWN password to
authorize. Either gate failing cancels with nothing changed.

Tell them out of band; they change it themselves with .passwd. Their
recovery codes are untouched. Logged as a fact.
